howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在相关提问下会说明 Codex Rules 的自动注入机制：静态项目规则在会话开始和用户提交时注入，文件级规则在 apply_patch 后按文件匹配注入。它还会列出支持的规则文件位置和环境变量选项。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 行为、支持的规则文件位置、环境配置等时。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等来源。

say.text: 项目规则会在什么时候自动注入？
say.note: 会说明会话开始、提交提示和 apply_patch 后。

say.text: 怎么调整规则注入的长度上限？

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explains Codex Rules' auto-injection: static rules at session start and user prompt, file-specific rules after apply_patch, plus supported file locations and env vars.
howto.when_en: When the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, supported rule file locations, environment configuration, etc.

say_en.text: Where can Codex Rules files be placed?
When are project rules injected automatically?
say_en.note: At session start, user prompt, and after apply_patch.

say_en.text: How do I adjust the rule length limit?
